title: A plug of liquid filling a frictionless channel from a velocity inlet
source: Volume conservation: a channel of cross-section A fed at U holds the volume U t A plus the inlet cell's at time t, so the front is at x_f = U t + Δx; the extent of the cells at least half full reaches a cell face X when x_f = X − Δx/2

quantities.quantity: liquid volume at the end, (U t + Δx) Δx²
quantities.reason: the weakly compressible lattice: the plug's density is below ρ₀ by order Ma² (0.75 % at lattice speed 0.05; measured 0.11 % more volume for its mass)

quantities.quantity: time the front reaches x = 0.5, (0.5 − 1.5 Δx) / U
quantities.reason: the history samples every time step (1/64 s) and the plug's volume runs 0.1 % ahead by the lattice's compressibility: measured two steps early

quantities.quantity: relative mass error of the balance (mass − initial − injected)
quantities.reason: the mass exchange and the inlet accounting are exact; round-off over 768 steps
